prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE NEW professional contemporary graphic logo for Chinese company 达州礼林生态科技有限责任公司, brand 礼林生态 / LILIN ECO. The company spans software and systems, engineering and practical/ecological services. Core values 善心、善念、善行 mean care, thoughtful joining and purposeful action. Prefer a strong unique silhouette and a few broad shapes over dense hidden lettering. Derive subtle structure from 礼 turn/open hook and 林 paired support without forcing complete characters. Independent design: NO existing image reference. Construction: ONE WIDE SCULPTURAL SADDLE emblem: two broad opposing convex curves meet a SHORT STRAIGHT HORIZONTAL BRIDGE at an off-center shared joint. Upper contour descends, lower contour rises; ONE large hourglass-like white opening, but no complete hourglass vessel. Two clipped support feet recall 林, a short turning lip recalls 礼. Only three bold components, no circle, ribbon loop, petals, swoosh or literal bridge arches. Palette: Deep violet, bright crimson and a short fresh mint connector. PURE WHITE background, one centered standalone emblem with ample margins. DO NOT render any words or captions; a neutral company wordmark will be added separately for comparison. Medium visual weight with generous white cuts, crisp vector-like flat artwork. No mockup, decorative illustration, texture, 3D, shadows, global rainbow wash, generic stock icon, business-icon collage or copied established logo.
